text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed an EU hosted API tailwind over the last 48h that's eating into our reserved GPU runway. estimate attached, need quick triage.

ashwin: saw the spike too. looks correlated with the new embeddings-heavy onboarding flow (customer B). high qps of short embed calls.

liam: FYI billing flagged a mismatch on committed vs used in eu-west-1 yesterday. invoice shows 12% more on-demand than expected. filing ticket w/ finance.

maya: exact ask — can infra produce a 7-day sensitivity forecast showing: baseline demand, committed supply, expected shortfall at 90/95th pct, and cost delta if we route 20% traffic to us-central or enable burst credits? need numbers by EOD.

rafa: quick thought — we can temporarily throttle per-customer embed concurrency at the edge for that onboarding cohort. buys us reducing peak qps without changing model. low risk.

alex_f: putting rough numbers here from the last 48h logs (rolling 1h windows):
```
window_start,hosted_qps,reserved_capacity_gpus,est_shortfall_gpus
2026-03-16T02:00Z,18.6,12,1.4
2026-03-16T08:00Z,25.2,12,3.8
2026-03-17T14:00Z,31.9,12,7.9
```
These assume 2.5k qps per GPU for short embed bursts — we should validate that with perf team.

ops-bot: alert: eu-west-1_gpu_utilization > 85% for 3 consecutive 5m intervals (since 2026-03-17T13:55Z).

ashwin: if perf holds, routing 20% to us-central reduces peak shortfall to ~6.3 GPUs — still above reserved. but cost delta might be favorable compared to buying more reserved capacity. need finance calculation.

liam: finance ticket #8428 — asked for invoice reconciliation + what on-demand discounts / credits we can claim for the anomalous week. cc @maya @ashwin.

maya: action items:
- alex_f: run the 7-day sensitivity sim (baseline / +10% / +25% demand scenarios) and include per-region cost delta for routing to us-central vs using burst credits (due EOD).
- rafa: prototype edge-concurrency throttle and estimate latency impact (2h spike test).
- liam: escalate invoice + ask cloud rep about short-term on-demand credits for onboarding surge.
- ashwin: confirm perf assumption (2.5k qps per GPU) with runtime team.

maya: if we can't cover shortfall with routing/credits, we should debate a 3-month reserved top-up for eu-west-1. but let's get the numbers first.

rafa: +1 on testing throttle today. can run canary on 10% of that customer cohort.

alex_f: starting sim now, will post results and a CSV in this thread.

ops-bot: note: next autoscale policy evaluation scheduled in 55m (2026-03-17T15:30Z).

maya: thanks all. keep thread lean — just post numbers and short status updates. :thumbsup:
